segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Bandra! December is Wrapped. The year is ending, everyone is reflecting, and every member has a story told in classes, favourite trainers and peak hours. This month we show them that story, and help them write next year's.

segments.title: ₹18.5L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Bandra is 18.5 lakh rupees. That's 28 per cent more than last December. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 9.44 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 5 lakh, comebacks 3.33 lakh, and everything else 74,000. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 59 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 525 leads, 273 trials, and 59 buyers, with about 22 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.

Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 14.2 lakh rupees, which is 77 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Resolution Pre-Order (Ships 1 Jan)
segments.text: First up, the Resolution Pre-Order. Ships first of January. Buy now, start between the first and tenth of January, and a coach checks in during week one so it actually sticks. That's 7 buyers, for 1.2 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: Next, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. That's 16 buyers, for 32,000 rupees.

segments.title: Last Seen: 2026 (We Noticed)
segments.text: Then, for long-lapsed members, Last Seen, 2026. We noticed. Fifteen per cent off, a free comeback class, and a spot on the Stronger in 30 comeback track, before the new year. That's 8 buyers, for 1.38 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Wrapped: Your Top Artist Was Your Trainer
segments.text: Also this month, Wrapped. Your top artist was your trainer. Every member gets their year in classes, trainers and peak hours, and next year's plan, priced for how they actually train. That's 14 buyers, for 7.7 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 12 Days of Shakemas
segments.text: And finally, the finale, Twelve Days of Shakemas. A new published deal every day from the thirteenth to the twenty-fourth. That's 12 buyers, for 3.6 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: One deal per person per day

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Wrapped cards go out to every member. Week two, twelve days of Shakemas begin on the thirteenth. Week three, gift vouchers and resolution pre-orders for the I'll start in January crowd. Week four, last-seen members get their invitation home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Bandra. 18.5 lakh rupees, five offers, and 59 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
